links.outcome: Expert versus GPT-based ratings of AI-generated versus human-written reply letters
links.effect: Experts rated human-written letters higher in accuracy (4.77 vs. 4.21, p < 0.001) and appropriateness (4.90 vs. 4.63, p < 0.001), whereas GPT-based evaluations rated AI-generated letters higher across all dimensions.
links.quote: Experts rated human-written letters higher in accuracy (4.77 vs. 4.21, p < 0.001) and appropriateness (4.90 vs. 4.63, p < 0.001), whereas GPT-based evaluations rated AI-generated letters higher across all dimensions.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid expert plus LLM-as-judge scoring to improve evaluator consistency
Instruction-tuning a smaller open model on GPT-4.1-generated data for multi-document reply letter generation

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an instruction-tuned LLM for generating clinical reply letters using retrospective hospital records evaluated by experts and GPT-based metrics, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
